name: 5dive-email
description: The 5dive email plugin (the `5dive email` verb and the email channel): each agent gets its own email address, in the firm's mailbox or on the firm's own server.

plugins.name: email
plugins.description: Each agent gets its own email address: in a mailbox the firm already runs (Google Workspace or any IMAP and SMTP server), or on the server's own mail server for a domain the firm points at it. Mail arrives as a chat and the agent answers in the same thread. A first mail from someone new, and a first mail to someone new, each wait for the owner's tap. 5dive hosts no mail.
